svg.title: Avernet OpenAPI — architecture around the Gateway

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Avernet OpenAPI — architecture around the Gateway
One configuration-driven edge in front of six services. Every route below is a line in the gateway’s application.yaml, not a hand-written handler.
third-party integration against the public API
app token + access key ⇒ App / AccessKey
credential in the handshake query string
the one front door for /openapi/v1 and /api/v1 · community edition on :8889
FastAPI · dependency-injector · one catch-all HTTP route + one WS route per socket domain
unknown domain ⇒ 404, never an open proxy
one ordered strategy chain per identity
every resolved identity is signed into
key comes from the secret resolver
upstreams trust this token, not the caller
WS: upstream opened BEFORE the client
is accepted, then frames relayed both ways
Each upstream’s OpenAPI description is read from file, http or object
store and refreshed every 300s, then merged into the gateway’s own
/openapi.json and /docs. The public API doc is generated, not written.
applications · access keys · tenants · bots — SQLite on a single box,
MariaDB when deployed. Cache: in-memory stub or Redis.
Admin endpoints issue the very credentials stages 3–4 verify.
EVERY STAGE IS A PLUGGABLE SEAM
SPI Protocol → bare/stub implementation → PluginContainer selector,
chosen in application.yaml: forwarder, schema_catalog, cache, database,
secret, authn.*. Enterprise builds register extra options at bootstrap.
Adding an upstream, a route rule or an identity is a configuration change — the gateway serves no hand-written per-operation route.
UPSTREAM SERVICES — THE DOMAIN SELECTS THE SERVER, CONFIG SUPPLIES ITS ADDRESS
(BaaS also serves its own API-key and
The internal hop in front of engine
and sandbox pods; JWT + target resolve.
checked by this hop, not by the edge
RUNTIME FABRIC BEHIND THE PLANE THE GATEWAY FRONTS
claude_code · openclaw adapters over an ACL
pods provisioned by BaaS, reached via the proxy
MariaDB · Redis · object store for published schemas
HTTP forward — path verbatim, response streamed back unchanged
WebSocket relay — upstream dialled first, frames relayed both ways
Ports are the single-box defaults; a deployment overrides every base_url. Some legacy direct-to-service routes still run alongside this edge.
